tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Core brand crimson, carried from the prototype. Reference only. Use the semantic tokens below in UI.

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper crimson from the prototype. Reference for `band` in dark mode.

tokens.name: crimson-black
tokens.usage: Near-black crimson. The hero ground in both modes.

tokens.name: logo-maroon
tokens.usage: The exact red of the logo's pen nib and lens. Only for recreating the mark, never as UI colour.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: warm paper. Dark: crimson-black. Text on it: `text`, `text-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alternating sections (album, FAQ), cards and form fields. A blush tint in light mode, oxblood in dark. `text` 14.9:1 / 16:1, `text-muted` 5.5:1 / 9.8:1.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Signature crimson bands: proof strip, booking section, active filter chip, hovered service row. Use `on-band` and `on-band-muted` text.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The hero's ground under the reel. Use `on-band` text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `bg` and `surface` (≥14:1 in both modes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and helper copy on `bg` and `surface` (≥5.5:1 light, ≥9.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Crimson text: links, italic emphasis words in headlines, step numbers, active nav. On `bg`: 8.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. On `surface`: 7.5:1 light, 7:1 dark. Also the focus ring on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Text is `on-primary` (8.4:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons. `on-primary` stays ≥6.5:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover`.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headlines, body and buttons on `band` and `hero` (≥8.4:1). Also the focus ring on those grounds.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `band` (6.2:1 light, 9:1 dark) and `hero`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input borders, outline buttons and meaningful dividers on `bg` / `surface` (≥3.3:1 in both modes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between list rows. Purely decorative, so it may stay below 3:1.

tokens.name: tally
tokens.usage: The REC dot and the “Now accepting requests” indicator only. It's a mark, not a fill (≥4:1 on `bg`).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Capturing the moments of every UNCean.
styles.usage: Hero headline only. Set one emphasis word in italic `maroon`. Drops to 56px on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Service names in the services list and the booking call-to-action headline.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Step titles, FAQ questions, album titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tell us about your event and the rate your organization can offer.
styles.usage: Hero intro and section lead paragraphs, max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Requests are reviewed within a few days of submission.
styles.usage: Default running text, form help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links and eyebrows. Always uppercase.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Submit at least 7 days before the first day of your event.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Photo captions, step numbers (01–04), camera-style details such as f/2.8 · 1/250. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to headline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap in the album.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; block spacing inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every page section on desktop (64px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos and album tiles: square, editorial edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The booking form panel and video frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips. Carried over from the prototype's rounded-full buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. The system separates things with hairlines and grounds, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the booking form panel when it opens as an overlay.
